verdict.rationale: Pika documents its own programmatic surfaces: an API (Pika API Club) covering 100+ video, image, audio and LLM models, and a Pika MCP that brings its 40+ creative apps into agent conversations. Nothing shows that the API covers every UI feature, such as the app workflows, character sheets, editing tools and account or billing actions. The MCP is agent-facing rather than a general API. missing for 10: an API reference documenting endpoints for the creative apps, explicit UI–API parity statement, account/credit management via API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Pika API Club: One API for 100+ leading video, image, audio, and LLM models.
A membership program that provides access to top gen media models at previously impossible prices, all through one API
Pika MCP: Connect Pika MCP to ChatGPT, Claude, OpenClaw, and other MCP-compatible agents.
40+ creative apps and 100+ gen media models for images, video, and sound, without leaving your conversation.
